title: Anunnaki came to Earth to mine gold

tellings.quote: the story of the Anunnaki. They were coming here to mine gold and precious metals.

plain: The Anunnaki, gods from the myths of ancient Mesopotamia, came to Earth to mine gold and other precious metals. A pyramid researcher named Geoffrey Drumm tells Michels "the story of the Anunnaki" this way, without naming a source, on an episode where he says an alien showed him the true purpose of the pyramids. Read like that, the old myth would be a memory of visitors from elsewhere coming here to dig for metal.
